title: Split repository page into focused modules
summary: Refactored the 2,926-line repository page into a thin data-loading seam plus focused header, overview, sidebar, pull-request, comparison, activity, artifacts, and shared utility modules without changing routes, UI behavior, API calls, or public test exports.
userVisibleChange: No intentional user-visible behavior change; the repository page is easier to maintain and each responsibility now has a focused module.

risks.title: Cross-module import seams could drift
risks.mitigation: Focused repository-page, loading, artifact, full UI, build, and Go verification all pass.

risks.title: Other large UI files remain
risks.mitigation: The final inventory is reported so they can be handled as separate focused refactors.

timeline.title: Inventoried UI file sizes and page seams
timeline.summary: Found the repository page at 2,926 lines and two other UI source files above 1,000 lines.

timeline.title: Extracted focused repository modules
timeline.summary: Split the page into nine modules, preserving the existing repository-page.tsx import surface.

timeline.title: Verified behavior and size targets
timeline.summary: 70 UI tests, the production UI build, Go tests, whitespace checks, and final line-count inventory passed.

decisions.title: Keep the existing page import seam
decisions.rationale: The route and existing tests continue to import repository-page.tsx, which now re-exports the stable public surface while the implementation lives in focused modules.

decisions.title: Split by feature responsibility
decisions.rationale: Header/navigation, sidebar, pull requests, comparison, activity, artifacts, and overview each have narrow typed interfaces that keep related behavior local.

decisions.title: Leave unrelated large files unchanged
decisions.rationale: The inventory found two other files above 1,000 lines, but neither was required for this repository-page refactor; broadening scope would add risk without a requested behavior change.

validation.output: TypeScript check and Vite production build passed.

validation.command: find ui/src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' \) -print0 | xargs -0 wc -l | sort -nr | awk '$1 > 1000 {print}'
validation.output: Only repository-activity-view.tsx (1140) and pull-request-page.tsx (1121) remain above 1000 lines.
